name: Greenworks GCS80420
blurb: 18″ bar, 3/8″ low profile chain, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links (Oregon S62), from Oregon's saw-chain selection guide.
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide gives Greenworks GCS80420 its own line: Oregon S62, a 18″ bar, 62 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not print a file size. Oregon's line reads GCS80420, GCS80421, 200002 80V.

bars.note: Oregon prints S62 for this model line: 18″ bar, 62 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 9 Nov 2026. The row restates the model line Oregon prints for this saw. Oregon does not print a file size on that line.
